TotalPoints.Name: How many circles
TotalPoints.Hint: Fixed size of the shared pool (1–20). Hero + Villain always equals this total.

DefaultHero.Name: How many start as Hero
DefaultHero.Hint: Opening Hero balance when the pool is first created or repaired. Does not reset an existing campaign pool.

AllowPlayerFlip.Name: Allow players to click
AllowPlayerFlip.Hint: When on, player clicks request a flip that a present GM applies. When off, only GMs can change the pool.

AnnounceFlips.Name: Announce flips in chat
AnnounceFlips.Hint: When on, each flip posts a short public chat line with the new balance.

AnnounceTides.Name: Announce tide moments
AnnounceTides.Hint: When on, chat calls out when the pool swings lead or becomes all Hero / all Villain.

ShowSceneControl.Name: Show toolbar button
ShowSceneControl.Hint: Adds a token-controls button to open or close the tracker (this client only).

PlaySound.Name: Play flip sound
PlaySound.Hint: Soft click when the shared pool changes (this client only).

CircleSize.Name: Circle size
CircleSize.Hint: How large the circles appear for you.

AutoOpen.Name: Open tracker on load
AutoOpen.Hint: Automatically open the Hero / Villain window when you join the world.

ColorHero.Name: Hero circle color
ColorHero.Hint: Fill color for Hero circles. Default: Warm Ivory (#E8E0C8).

ColorHeroBorder.Name: Hero circle trim
ColorHeroBorder.Hint: Border color for Hero circles. Default: Antique Gold (#D2A33A).

ColorVillain.Name: Villain circle color
ColorVillain.Hint: Fill color for Villain circles. Default: Eldergate Blue (#183159).

ColorVillainBorder.Name: Villain circle trim
ColorVillainBorder.Hint: Border color for Villain circles. Default: Charcoal (#282421).

ColorPanel.Name: Panel base color
ColorPanel.Hint: Darker end of the tracker background. Default: Charcoal (#282421).

ColorPanelAlt.Name: Panel highlight color
ColorPanelAlt.Hint: Richer end of the tracker background gradient. Default: Eldergate Blue (#183159).

ColorAccent.Name: Accent / embroidery
ColorAccent.Hint: Gold trim for focus rings and highlights. Default: Antique Gold (#D2A33A).

ColorCopper.Name: Fixture / copper detail
ColorCopper.Hint: Secondary warm metal used in subtle mixes. Default: Aged Copper (#9E7D67).

Controls.ToggleKeybindHint: Open or close the shared Hero / Villain window.

Warnings.NoGM: No Game Master is present to apply that flip. The pool is unchanged.
Warnings.NotAllowed: Only the Game Master can flip points right now.
Warnings.RequestSent: Flip requested — waiting for the Game Master.

Chat.TideAllHero: Tide shift: the pool is all Hero ({hero}–{villain}).
Chat.TideAllVillain: Tide shift: the pool is all Villain ({hero}–{villain}).
Chat.TideSwungHero: Tide shift: Heroes take the lead ({hero}–{villain}).
Chat.TideSwungVillain: Tide shift: Villains take the lead ({hero}–{villain}).
